title: The Quiet City
pages:
Under the deepslate there is a city nobody built.

Sculk grows over the doorways like a held breath. I took my boots off. It helped.

Every step is a question here, and the floor writes down the answer.

He hid in this city once. Not from a mob. From the sound he made himself.

Something sleeps at the bottom.

I do not wake it. It only ever wakes itself, and only when it has heard enough.
